verdict.rationale: Dover's first-party docs describe webhooks that send HTTPS requests from Dover to a user-chosen URL when events happen. They also document a Test action that sends a sample event to an active endpoint, which is a registrable outbound callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The Slack notifications are excluded because chat-app delivery does not count as webhooks. missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog and payload schema, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
